meta.name: deflake
meta.description: Finds flaky tests on the main branch by analyzing GitHub Actions failures, ranks them by frequency, and enters parallel plan mode to design deflake strategies. Use when you want to find and fix the flakiest tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出并修复主分支上最不稳定的测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常被主分支上的不稳定测试困扰
copy.tagline_en: Find and fix the flakiest tests on the main branch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are often troubled by flaky tests on the main branch

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 GitHub Actions 上 main 分支的测试失败记录，找出最不稳定的测试（flaky tests），按失败次数排序，并制定修复方案。
howto.when: 当你要求查找和修复最不稳定的测试时触发，例如说“找出最 flaky 的测试”或“分析测试稳定性”。

say.text: 帮我找出 main 分支上最 flaky 的测试。
say.note: Claude 会收集数据并生成报告。

say.text: 分析前 5 个 flaky 测试并给出修复计划。
say.note: Claude 会并行调查并给出方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze GitHub Actions failures on the main branch, identify flaky tests, rank them by frequency, and propose deflake strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find and fix flaky tests, e.g., 'find the flakiest tests' or 'analyze test stability'.

say_en.text: Find the flakiest tests on the main branch.
say_en.note: Claude will collect data and generate a report.

say_en.text: Analyze the top 5 flaky tests and propose fixes.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate in parallel and present plans.
